## Formas de la distribución Beta según los parámetros

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 7
#| warning: false

par(
  mfrow = c(2,3),
  mar = c(4,4,3,1),
  bg = "white",
  family = "sans"
)

# Parámetros Beta
params <- list(
  c(1,1),
  c(2,2),
  c(5,2),
  c(0.5,0.5),
  c(2,5),
  c(5,1)
)

# Títulos
titles <- c(
  expression(Beta(1,1)),
  expression(Beta(2,2)),
  expression(Beta(5,2)),
  expression(Beta(0.5,0.5)),
  expression(Beta(2,5)),
  expression(Beta(5,1))
)

# Colores
cols <- c(
  "#1f4e79",
  "#2e7d32",
  "#b23a48",
  "#7b1fa2",
  "#d17a22",
  "#00838f"
)

# Valores de x
x <- seq(0.001, 0.999, length = 600)

# Crear gráficos
for(i in seq_along(params)) {

  a <- params[[i]][1]
  b <- params[[i]][2]

  y <- dbeta(x, a, b)

  plot(
    x, y,
    type = "l",
    lwd = 4,
    col = cols[i],
    main = titles[i],
    xlab = "x",
    ylab = "f(x)",
    cex.main = 1.3,
    cex.lab = 1.1,
    cex.axis = 1,
    ylim = c(0, max(y)*1.10)
  )

  grid(col = "gray88")

  # Área sombreada
  polygon(
    c(x, rev(x)),
    c(y, rep(0, length(y))),
    col = adjustcolor(cols[i], alpha.f = 0.18),
    border = NA
  )

  # Curva nuevamente encima
  lines(x, y, lwd = 4, col = cols[i])

  # Línea vertical en la media
  abline(v = a/(a+b), lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "gray35")

}
```
